import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/training_1.csv"

Source5_30_0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
Source5_30_1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source5_30_0 and Source5_30_1 on "school_name"
joined_df = pd.merge(Source5_30_0, Source5_30_1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Operation 2: GROUP BY Source5_30_1.Student ID, Source5_30_1.school_name
# Aggregations: sum(Source5_30_0.budget), avg(Source5_30_1.math_score), avg(Source5_30_1.reading_score)

# Grouping columns
group_cols = ['Student ID', 'school_name']

# Perform aggregation
agg_df = joined_df.groupby(group_cols).agg(
    budget=pd.NamedAgg(column='budget', aggfunc='sum'),
    math_score=pd.NamedAgg(column='math_score', aggfunc='mean'),
    reading_score=pd.NamedAgg(column='reading_score', aggfunc='mean')
).reset_index()

# Reorder columns and rename to match target schema:
# Target schema: ['school_name': string, 'Student ID': integer, 'budget': integer, 'math_score': float, 'reading_score': float]

# Ensure types:
agg_df['school_name'] = agg_df['school_name'].astype(str)
agg_df['Student ID'] = agg_df['Student ID'].astype(int)
agg_df['budget'] = agg_df['budget'].round().astype(int)
agg_df['math_score'] = agg_df['math_score'].astype(float)
agg_df['reading_score'] = agg_df['reading_score'].astype(float)

# Reorder columns to match target schema order
Target5_30 = agg_df[['school_name', 'Student ID', 'budget', 'math_score', 'reading_score']]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/target_multisource.csv"
Target5_30.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name (inner join to keep only matching schools)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by school_name (the primary key in target)
# Aggregations:
# - Student ID: max (to get a single representative ID per school, since Student ID is unique per student)
# - budget: sum (budget is per school, but source0 has one row per school, so sum is safe)
# - math_score: average
# - reading_score: average
agg = joined.groupby("school_name").agg({
    "Student ID": "max",
    "budget": "sum",
    "math_score": "mean",
    "reading_score": "mean"
}).reset_index()

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
agg = agg[["school_name", "Student ID", "budget", "math_score", "reading_score"]]

# Write output
agg.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
